IndustrialMarket: India’s Most Trusted B2B E-commerce Platform for Industrial Supplies

IndustrialMarket is India’s most trusted B2B e-commerce platform, catering to all industrial and business supply needs. From tools and machinery to safety gear and hardware, it’s the one-stop destination for reliable and efficient sourcing.

Top B2B Categories Selling on Industrial Market:

1. Hand Tools

The Hand Tools category offers a comprehensive range including spanners, wrenches, pliers, hammers, screw drivers, sockets, cutters, handles, and allen keys with or without handles. It also features essential workshop tools like C-clamps, bench vices, bearing pullers, punches, greases, and oil cans, ensuring reliability and performance in every industrial task.

2. Abrasives

The Abrasives category includes high-performance tools such as cutting wheels, grinding wheels, flap discs, mounted flap wheels, and fiber discs designed for precision surface finishing. It also features versatile options like sand paper with Velcro, abrasive rolls, belts, sector wheels, and waterproof paper to meet a wide range of industrial grinding and polishing needs.

3. Polishing

The Polishing category offers specialized solutions for achieving smooth, refined finishes with products like non-woven polishing wheels, hand pads, felt discs, and combi wheels. It also includes buffing essentials such as jute and cotton buff wheels, luster soap, spindle mops, and non-woven hand pads for both manual and machine polishing applications.

4. Bearings

The Bearings category features high-quality components designed to reduce friction and enhance performance, including ball bearings, roller bearings, and thrust bearings. It also includes pillow block bearings, industrial and special bearings, along with essential accessories like locking nuts for secure and efficient operation in industrial machinery.

5. Welding

The Welding category offers a complete range of solutions for industrial and fabrication needs, including welding electrodes, machines, and safety equipment. It also features essential tools like gas cutting torches, soldering accessories, and high-quality welding wires and cables for efficient and safe operations
